# Your voice-note present

Drop your recording here as **voice-note.m4a**. The gift dialog will automatically show a player. Put the words you say into **transcript.txt** for the optional readable transcript.

For M4A or another supported audio format, keep its real extension and change voiceNote in ../../content.js. The current M4A recording is connected to the player.

## The final line

Edit **ending.txt** for the personal sentence revealed after the recording finishes. This file contains your closing line. The player includes pause, replay, and your optional transcript. Its decorative waveform moves only while audio is actually playing and stays still when reduced motion is enabled.
